prompt: You understand a lot of spoken Spanish but freeze when you have to speak it yourself. Which small practice most directly targets speaking?

options.text: Learn another fifty vocabulary words from a list
Read through the grammar rules once more
Record yourself speaking for two minutes a day on a familiar topic, and listen back once

explanation: Speaking is its own skill, so it improves with speaking practice. Short daily recordings on familiar topics give you regular, low-pressure speaking reps and a way to hear your own progress.
